scope.summary: Implement the asset-browser surface that lists local and enabled-library components with text search, section grouping by library and by document page, and drag-to-insert (operator) / typed-insert (model, MT-324) instantiation. Component and style organization uses slash-path names (e.g. Button/Primary/Large) that render as nested picker folders; the slash-path is a naming convention on the name, not a distinct folder entity.
acceptance_criteria: asset browser lists local+library components with search/grouping/drag-insert; slash-path folders; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: asset browser reachable with stable author_ids; text search + library/page grouping + drag-insert
test: slash-path names render as nested folders without a folder entity; typed-insert parity with drag-insert

target_entries: Studio / Design Systems / The asset browser

risk_if_missed: No asset browser; components not discoverable or insertable by operator.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
